lessons_used: For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption, new_flow, finish, choose_path, sign_in, and home redesign changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
The choose_path reorder change was helpful, winning Round 4 (+12.0% after noise correction).
The home redesign change was helpful, winning Round 6 (+3.6% after noise correction).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early.
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect or negative results, but underpredicted the major winning test in Round 4.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Split Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout separating photo guidelines from upload inputs.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9% conversion.

upload_photos.headline: Create your custom companion
upload_photos.body: Upload a photo or choose a pet reference image to ensure clear AI pet generation.

guard.reason: Redesigns photo upload screen within allowed onboarding customization rules.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with support tickets; layout redesign carries moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Recovery Warning Hint
candidates.change: Displays a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding users to log into their original account to preserve pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Use your existing account to ensure your pet status and progress are preserved.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful account recovery hint on the sign-in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; simple hint update with low implementation cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Transforms the home intro screen into an interactive visual carousel demonstrating drag, hide, and chat controls.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% (median 395s) and 3 support emails reported confusion on controlling or hiding the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Swipe through quick cards to learn how to drag, hide, right-click, and chat with your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro screen into a carousel layout, which is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off and post-onboarding confusion, but requires heavy UI redesign.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Stage Estimated Progress
candidates.change: Shows a live progress bar and estimated time remaining during the background pet generation wait stage.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a long mean time of 2336s; clear time estimates reduce user drop-off while waiting.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home
waiting.body: Your pet is getting ready. This usually takes around 2 to 3 minutes.

guard.reason: Provides progress and estimated wait time during pet generation, which is allowed for real waits.

candidates.score_note: Long average wait time supported by funnel data; low support email signal.

candidates.title: Choose Path Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Arranges path selection options side-by-side in a two-column comparison card layout.
candidates.why: Mean time in choose_path is 514s; presenting options in a balanced two-column format speeds up decision making.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Select whether you want to adopt a standard pet companion or generate a custom friend.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while retaining options for both adopting and creating your own pet.

candidates.score_note: Step conversion is already high (89.4%), though path improvements previously performed well.

candidates.title: Guided Adoption Name Step Flow
candidates.change: Enables a step counter and structured workflow on the adoption certificate screen to guide naming and completion.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate and 89s median time; step-by-step guidance reduces drop-off.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name & Finalize Your Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a memorable name before bringing them to your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a structured step flow to the adoption certificate screen while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: High impact potential at adoption step, but new_flow tests previously showed minimal lift (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Welcome Reward
candidates.change: Adds an exclusive starter badge element on the final onboarding screen celebrating completion.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 21.7%; rewarding users at the final stage improves completion rates.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions an unlocked companion pack/reward, violating the restriction against mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Explicit Account Protection Copy
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize cloud saving of pet progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing pets due to sign-in account mix-ups; clearer messaging prevents duplicate accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings are saved securely to your account.

guard.reason: Updates sign-in copy to emphasize account saving without requesting new personal data or violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high email volume (8 emails) via quick copy configuration change.

candidates.title: Story Intro Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into a centered visual card presentation.
candidates.why: While median choose_path time is 8s, the long mean time (514s) indicates some users stall; a focused card layout keeps attention clear.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Meet your cute digital companion living directly on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Targets long mean decision time on choose_path, but step conversion is already high.

candidates.title: Background Generation Completion Notification
candidates.change: Adds a notification option allowing users to minimize the app and get notified when pet creation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; enabling desktop notifications lets users multitask without abandoning onboarding.

waiting.body: You can safely minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds completion notification feature on the waiting screen, allowed under onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: Helps mitigate extreme wait time (2336s), but requires system notification capability.

lessons_next: For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
The choose_path reorder change was helpful, winning Round 4 (+11.9% after noise correction).
The home redesign change was helpful, winning Round 6 (+3.6% after noise correction).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.1% after noise correction) and was stopped early.
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_flow and redesign), choose_path, sign_in, and home redesign changes, as only one test of each kind has been completed.
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect or negative results, but underpredicted the major winning test in Round 4.
